situation: A visitor stands inside a grand exhibition hall looking at an ancient artifact kept behind a glass case.
subject: the museum building interior displaying old and valuable objects
brief: A cross-section of a grand vaulted hall shows high arched ceilings, polished parquet floors, and three tall glass display pedestals holding a glowing golden crown, an ancient stone tablet, and a fragile glass vase. A solitary visitor in a coat stands small in the center, gazing up at the exhibits under precise track lighting from above.
prompt: A cross-section of a grand vaulted hall shows high arched ceilings, polished parquet floors, and three tall glass display pedestals holding a glowing golden crown, an ancient stone tablet, and a fragile glass vase. A solitary visitor in a coat stands small in the center, gazing up at the exhibits under precise track lighting from above. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
